slither - bounded repository evidence and review packets

Usage:
  slither <command> [flags]

Commands:
  version      print build provenance
  doctor       read-only configuration and local model readiness
  outputs      choose a report, protocol, or ledger output
  completion   generate dependency-free shell completion
  report       scan a repository into a ranked evidence report
  agent        run the bounded JSONL agent bridge
  eval         evaluate outcome-ledger labels against reports

Run slither help <command> or slither <command> --help for flags, limits, examples, and output behavior.
